غَرَّافٌ A river, or channel of running water, having much water. (O, K.) ―
-b2- And A copious rain: occurring in this sense in a verse: or, as some relate it, the word is there عَزَّاف [q. v.]. (TA.) ―
-b3- And A horse wide in step; that takes much of the ground with his legs. (AZ, O, K. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
